$comment: The Journeyman's Toolbelt round the guildhall yard (docs/specs/ISLAND-04-guildcrest.md §5.3): Rory's indenture (the agent profile), his toolbelt (tools: read and search), the proof, the hall's doors (quit and reopen), the roll call (/agent), his explanation at the bench, and the tests back to the default agent. The places, lamps and controls are the game's; every word is this file's.

laps.title: The Journeyman’s Toolbelt: a read-only explainer

stations.title: Write the agent profile
stations.prompt: Rory’s indenture needs its parts. What goes in it?

options.text: A name, a description, a tools list, and his instructions below the frontmatter
options.result: Signed: `book-app-explainer`, with a role and an answer format.

options.text: A session mode and a model
options.reason: A custom agent isn’t a different session mode, or necessarily a different model.
Without `name` and `description`, the agent picker can’t show him. Without `tools`, he gets every tool.

hints: What does the profile table list?
Frontmatter first, then the Markdown below.
A name, a description, a tools list, and his instructions.

stations.title: Choose the tools
stations.prompt: Fit Rory’s toolbelt for one job: explain the Book App without changing it.

tiles.reason: He can’t run commands. That’s the default agent’s job.
His instructions say no external services.
Omitting `tools` would allow all available tools.

stations.title: Inspect Changes
stations.prompt: The proof board shows the new profile. What do you check?

options.result: Read and search: nothing else on the belt.

options.reason: Length isn’t the check. The tools list is.

options.text: That Copilot also updated the skill
options.reason: This step creates one file. Send any other edits back.

stations.title: Load the new agent
stations.prompt: Rory waits outside. The hall opens its doors only at dawn. How do you bring him in?

options.text: Wait for work in every session to finish, quit the app, and open it again
options.result: The app loads custom agents when it starts.

options.reason: Closing a window isn’t the same as quitting the app.
Don’t start from `main` again to reload uncommitted files.

hints: When does the app load custom agents?
At dawn: when the app starts.
Let the work finish, quit the app, and open it again.

stations.title: Select the agent

options.text: Type `/agent`, pick **book-app-explainer**, send it, and check the agent picker shows him
options.result: The agent picker below the prompt box reads `book-app-explainer`.

options.reason: That’s how a skill shows in the `/` menu. You select a custom agent with `/agent`.
You find skills in **Customize**. You select custom agents with `/agent` or the agent picker.

hints: Which slash command selects an agent?
Then check the agent picker below the prompt box.

stations.title: Ask it to explain
stations.prompt: Rory sits at the bench with `App.tsx`.
stations.action: Ask Rory how the Unread filter reaches the stats
stations.text: Rory traces `filters` through `filterBooks` to `filteredBooks`, then to `ReadingStats` and the book cards, in his four-part format. Nothing on the bench changes.

stations.title: Run the tests
stations.prompt: Now the tests must run. Rory’s belt has no hammer. What do you do?

options.text: Switch back to the default agent, and run them there
options.result: The guild’s own crew runs the tests. Rory’s belt stays as it is.

options.text: Give Rory the hammer: add shell access
options.reason: Don’t add shell access just to make the read-only agent run tests.

options.text: Ask Rory to say they passed
options.reason: He can inspect tests but can’t run them. Don’t claim tests passed.

hints: Switch back to the default agent and run the tests there.

text.title: The Journeyman’s Toolbelt
text.intro: Write the profile, fit the tools, check it, load it, select it, use it, and leave the tests to the default agent.
